searchText: What was the reasoning again of having tx type 3v1 , instead of type 4? Just catching up on this. A big part of this is likely due to the computation bottleneck in the existing version where CL has to compute proofs for all blobs after getBlobs. <@288990561279541248> ‘s report shows from 20 blobs, the computation time frequently hit 4s+ and then 10+s on higher blob counts. I suspect that we might see better results _without_ getBlobs with this version, if bandwidth isn’t tightly constrained - with this version every node on the network spend excessive CPU cycles on proof computation on every block Keen to see results once we offload computation from beacon nodes Oh I was trying to reply to this message^ I agree, the offloading is a big deal here. The networking stack itself is (can be) IMHO very efficient if proof computation is not on the critical path. Reth Qs 🧵

excerpts.content: Just catching up on this. A big part of this is likely due to the computation bottleneck in the existing version where CL has to compute proofs for all blobs after getBlobs. <@288990561279541248> ‘s report shows from 20 blobs, the computation time frequently hit 4s+ and then 10+s on higher blob counts. I suspect that we might see better results _without_ getBlobs with this version, if bandwidth isn’t tightly constrained - with this version every node on the network spend excessive CPU cycles on proof computation on every block
